categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and modifies log escaping logic in src/logging.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents terminal injection attacks by ensuring UTF-8 C1 control characters are properly escaped in log output. As described, terminal emulators like VTE decode two-byte C1 sequences as control sequences (CSI, OSC, DCS), allowing untrusted log input to manipulate user terminals.
